about: Text that was on a page verbatim when a DES/Fidelity record quoted it, and was later reworded in the display-layer section rename (founder, 1405/08/17). Records are never hand-edited; verify_publish.py accepts a quote that is on the page today OR listed here for that page. Add an entry only when a page's wording changes for a reason that is not a content correction, with the exact retired text.
